title: Separating EAL notation, evidence correction and engineering transfer
question: Can EAL notation improve correctness under equivalent semantics, and can relevant raw evidence correct an initially wrong proposed answer, beyond preserving already correct answers?

scope.system_or_population: Diagnostic: five exposed engineering-v2.1-eal2 tasks with GPT-4.1 nano snapshot 2025-04-14. Confirmation: a future independent engineering task frame; model set to be frozen before new outcomes.
scope.conditions: Paired EAL/JSON meaning-equivalent arguments, identical semantic reference, fresh sessions, common response contract; artificial correct/incorrect candidate answers and five information conditions.
scope.spatial_scope: Local host and configured API; no physical apparatus or human subjects.
scope.temporal_scope: Diagnostic follows this freeze; confirmation requires a later protocol version with protected tasks and a calibrated information target.
exclusions: A cognitive mechanism inferred from endpoint labels
Natural producer-error prevalence inferred from injected errors
Notation effect inferred from unmatched tool access
Fresh held-out claims for the existing suite

design.rationale: Separates surface representation, raw evidence, scope-irrelevant records and computed conclusions; includes incorrect proposals so correction is observable.
design.setting: Existing synthetic tasks followed by a separately frozen independent task investigation.
design.temporal_structure: Each task/repetition block runs all 18 conditions in random order with fresh sessions.
design.assignment_method: Seed 20260923; blocked randomised condition order; exact paired content.
design.allocation_concealment: Expected answers and manipulation labels stay in local scoring records, outside recipient prompts.
design.masking: Common response contract; proposed-answer correctness is undisclosed. Source syntax itself cannot be blinded.
design.comparator: Meaning-equivalent JSON; answer-only, irrelevant-record, computed-conclusion and raw-only conditions.

Model, task, proposed answer and common resources fixed. Assignment changes surface without changing semantics. Generalisation additionally depends on template sampling and measurement validity.

sampling.method: Diagnostic finite census of five selected exposed tasks; confirmation planning uses paired independent-template differences.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Diagnostic: 5 tasks x 18 conditions x 2 repetitions = 180 calls. Confirmation: examine 120, 240, 480 and 960 independent templates before choosing a feasible target.
inputs: Paired discordance probabilities 0.2, 0.4, 0.6; true differences 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15; 10000 synthetic replicates per cell.
sampling.dependence_structure: Repetitions perfectly dependent in planning sensitivity and count once; possible dependence between templates remains to be calibrated.
sampling.multiplicity: Future N and R primary tests each use one-sided alpha .025; additional model/domain comparisons need a larger predefined family.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain attempted failures; unexecuted scheduled calls excluded from outcome counts and shown explicitly.
sampling.result: Synthetic planning sensitivity records lower-bound coverage, decision frequency and Monte Carlo error; it is not a selected information target or an empirical EAL effect.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Alternative discordance and template counts; excludes provider drift, scoring error and between-template dependence. These need extension before confirmation.
sampling.stopping_implications: Diagnostic fixed schedule subject to cost/transport stops; no significance-based stopping. A complete confirmatory stopping rule remains to be frozen.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Strict common response schema; store raw responses and attempt metadata. No prompt repair within the diagnostic.
analysis.exclusion_lock: All attempted outcomes retained; no correctness-based exclusions. Pre-call credential failure is unexecuted, not a model failure. Labels correct/incorrect for injected proposals refer to the original full-information oracle, not necessarily the available-information oracle. Two repetition indices use different incorrect labels and therefore mix sampling variability with error type.

models.model_or_procedure: Paired counts and template-averaged differences on the finite exposed diagnostic; separate incorrect, correct and absent proposals. Also score against a condition-specific offline interpreter reference for the observations actually supplied; proposals are fallible assertions rather than evidence. Full-information agreement remains a separate retained outcome.
assumptions: Comparable semantic inputs and stable independent sessions.

models.model_or_procedure: Template-level paired estimation with calibrated uncertainty; independent-reference construction and revision scores for transfer. Estimator calibration and G thresholds required in a new version.

contrasts: Primary notation: EAL raw-only minus JSON raw-only.
Primary correction: answer_raw minus answer in incorrect-proposal stratum, reported separately by notation. Confirmation must preselect one primary representation.
Diagnostic controls: raw versus irrelevant and assessed; damage among correct proposals; raw-only versus proposed-answer conditions.
Report full-information agreement and available-information correctness separately. Raw-minus-irrelevant full-information agreement alone cannot establish scope discrimination.
Report raw-only versus each proposed-answer condition, explicit damage relative to the original reference, and task-by-condition correct/false-support counts.
analysis.uncertainty: Diagnostic descriptive counts; confirmation requires template-preserving uncertainty and small-sample calibration. Synthetic normal bounds are planning approximations only.
analysis.multiplicity: Diagnostic exploratory; no p-values. Future two primary one-sided contrasts Bonferroni at .025 each; no post-hoc selection of best model or representation.
analysis.missing_data: Malformed and failed attempted responses count as unsuccessful; unknown price stays unknown and stops new calls; orphaned attempts never silently retried.
analysis.stopping_rule: 180 scheduled diagnostic calls or first unknown usage/provider failure or next-call allowance breaching USD 2 threshold; preserve partial coverage.
robustness_checks: Separate injected errors from natural errors
Audit information content of raw packets
Retain input length and actual response model
software_and_versions: Script and runtime digests recorded in freeze; actual numerical package version in simulation output.
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Wide intervals, failed manipulation, invalid references or incomplete coverage do not strengthen the target empirical claim. Honest unsupported conclusions when records are absent or mismatched are not labelled reasoning failures merely because they differ from the full-information target.
